newsitem.title: GERMANY: Bremen coffee demand muted, nearby prices too high.
newsitem.headline: Bremen coffee demand muted, nearby prices too high.

text.p: Coffee demand for nearby shipment was sluggish in the Bremen market amid futures rallies on concerns about tight Latin American supply and the onset of the Brazilian frost season, traders said.
But roasters took cover for more distant dates, especially from the Brazilian new crop, which was on offer at attractive differentials.
Colombian and Central American offers were scarce and East African prices were prohibitively high.
Robusta traders reported good demand for Indonesian and Vietnamese coffees.
